name: pommipeli
description: PommiParty – real-time Finnish word-bomb party game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client -- --host"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
